## One request in full

POST /ipd/service/categories, from [its page](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/ipd/configuration/categories/create-category).

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.eka.care/ipd/service/categories' \
  -H 'auth: <auth>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
  "name": "ICU",
  "description": "Intensive Care Unit"
}'
```
